name: codex-mantle
description: A local-first, reversible control layer for OpenAI Codex configuration and extensions.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/codex-adapter packages/plugin-sdk packages/server apps/cli && pnpm --filter @codex-mantle/web build
scripts.check: pnpm version:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm repository:scan
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/codex-adapter packages/plugin-sdk packages/server apps/cli --pretty false && pnpm --filter @codex-mantle/web typecheck
